text:
Zoe P.: Heads-up: partner asked for an "orchestrator certification" badge that shows compatibility with LangChain/LlamaIndex workflows + Gateway adapter. They want it on the marketplace entry and partner landing page. Thoughts on requirements?
Kenji H.: We should require: conformance tests pass, sample manifest, metrics exposed, and a short perf note (H100/A100). Badge tiers: Partner Preview, Certified, and Certified+HW-optimized.
Renee M.: Marketing prefers single-line certified text: "Certified: LangChain & Gateway adapter (verified)". Need legal on claims.
Carlos (HW): HW wants a co-mark bundle option: if partner buys reserved H100 capacity with partner promo, we can list a "HW-accelerated" badge. Must include clear quantization caveat.
Nora (SI): SI ops need a deterministic rollout plan for customers: recommended replicas, batch sizes, fallback policy. Also want a CI job to run conformance for every partner PR.
Marketplace-Bot: SKU rules reminder: names <= 60 chars, use hyphens, include partner tag. Visibility flags: partner-only, public-beta, GA. Badges are metadata fields, max 3 per listing.
Elena (Legal): Any certification claim must be backed by test artifacts + signed partner agreement for co-mark. I'll draft a short certification attestation form.
Kenji H.: Proposed minimal certification checklist:
```
1) Sample deploy manifest (K8s)
2) Smoke script: /attach, /route, /metrics present
3) Fallback exercised: GPU -> cpu_quantized
4) Perf bullets for H100/A100 (sanitized)
5) Co-mark + logo form signed
```
Renee M.: Design ask: we want small SVG badge variants (light/dark) and two one-liners for marketplace and partner page. I'll prototype after we decide phrasing.
Carlos (HW): Hardware incentive idea: partner can opt into a "2-week H100 trial" for customers that activate through the marketplace. Needs ops support and a reserved quota window. We'll need SigmaCloud written confirmation.
Nora (SI): For CI conformance, here's a tiny manifest snippet teams can use:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lc-gateway-cert-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: adapter
        image: redwood/gateway-adapter:cert-preview
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Nora (SI): Also recommend a CI job that runs the smoke script and flips a badge flag in the draft listing if green.
Marketplace-Bot: Note: automated badge toggles must be reviewed by Marketplace Admins before public exposure (prevent accidental claims).
Elena (Legal): I'll prepare the attestation template and co-mark wording. Draft ETA: 48 hours. If partner requests "HW-accelerated" wording, need an appendix with benchmark artifacts.
Zoe P.: Timeline proposal: conformance artifacts by Mon, SI CI job merge Tue, badge draft & art Wed, partner preview Thu, public listing next Tue. Any objections?
Kenji H.: Ops maintenance Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC 14 avoid pushes then.
Renee M.: Can we get partner-approved copy for the landing page? Need to confirm whether to use "in collaboration with" or "powered by". Legal preference?
Elena (Legal): Prefer neutral "in collaboration with". "Powered by" requires exec sign-off and deeper endorsement language.
Carlos (HW): I'll ping SigmaCloud for reserved quota confirmation and attach the written note to the cert package.
Nora (SI): Action items:
- Nora: publish manifest + smoke script + CI example
- Kenji: coord with Ops on quota blackout & CI runners
- Carlos: secure written quota confirmation + sanitized perf artifacts
- Renee: badge designs + one-liners for marketplace
- Elena: attestation + co-mark wording
- Marketplace-Bot: create partner-draft listing and reserve badge slot
Zoe P.: If all go green, we'll show a Partner Preview badge on the draft listing and enable the HW-accelerated badge only after benchmarks + legal appendix.
Marketplace-Bot: Embargo rule: partner-preview listings visible to partner for 72h before public-beta. Social queue holds until "public-beta" flag lifted.
Renee M.: I'll drop initial badge SVGs in the drive and post link here when ready.
Kenji H.: Will add a small test harness to the CI job to intentionally trigger fallback and assert adapter.fallback.triggered metric increments.
Carlos (HW): ETA on benchmarks: 24h. Will sanitize and upload.
Elena (Legal): Posting attestation draft to the drive now. Please review.
Zoe P.: Great sync  I'll compile the certification package checklist and tag owners. Ping here with slips. End thread.
